text.en:
The dissolution and liquidation, in accordance with
Philippine and Australian laws, of PhilCorp Pty Ltd.
The Department of Agriculture and the Office of the
Government Corporate Counsel shall take the necessary steps to elect
and carry out the dissolution and liquidation process in dismantling
PhilCorp Pty Ltd.
The Department of Agriculture is hereby authorized to
utilize the remaining assets of PhilCorp Ply Ltd to purchase breeding
cattle from the Oceania Region for upgrading of the local livestock.
IN REPLYING, PLEASE CITE:
PFVR Letter:

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts
thereot inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are
hereby repealed and /or modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediatcly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of October
the year of Our Lord Nineteen Hundred and Ninety Five.
By the Presidents
PMS LICRARY
RUBEN D. TORRES
Executive Secretary
